title: Tia | Tia ignores what the user said earlier in the same chat and searches the records instead
summary: Tia does not reliably use the chat's own history. A fact the user states is treated as a record search, and when the user asks about it one message later Tia searches the records again instead of answering from the chat.
steps: In CRM, open Tia and start a new chat.
Send: For this chat, our project is called FALCON-A1 and its budget is 266 thousand. Just confirm.
Then send: What is the project called, and what is its budget?
expected: Tia confirms the first message and answers the second from the chat: "FALCON-A1, 266 thousand".
actual: First reply: "I could not find any record or data about a project named FALCON-A1 or its budget of 266 thousand in the workspace." Second reply: "There is no project record accessible in this workspace, so I cannot provide the project name or its budget." (once it offered an unrelated deal, "AEX-01", instead). Right in 1 of 10 chats.
more: Asked to remember a "personal code word", Tia recalled it in 52 of 60 chats; the other 8 times it replied "I cannot remember or retrieve your personal code word" one message after being given it.
Not related to load: it happened with one user alone as well as with 8 users at once.
No mix-up between users: in 50 chats with 8 users talking to Tia at the same time, no user ever received another user's code word.
Different from NDC-3339 (long chats): here the chat is only two messages long.
